title: Measure camshafts and journal clearance
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only

required_tools.name: Micrometer, Plastigauge covering0.028–0.062mm with its scale/instructions

required_parts.name: Exact stock replacement cams/head-cap set/chain if inspection requires

preflight: Cams removed; their original matching head/caps available.
entry_state: Cams removed; their original matching head/caps available.
exit_state: Cam/head inspection recorded and required replacement disposition determined; cams remain out.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Prepare the removed cams and matching head
steps.instruction: Use the original matching head and caps on the bench, with cams removed and identified by intake/exhaust. Keep cap locations and dowels matched; a mixed cap set is not an acceptable measurement fixture.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect and measure the lobes
steps.instruction: Replace a cam with blue discoloration, pitting or scratches. Measure lobe height at the illustrated axis: intake limit38.030mm, exhaust34.170mm. Record each lobe measurement and condition.
verification: All lobe heights and conditions saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Measure cam journal clearance
steps.instruction: Place the cam in its matching head and position a Plastigauge strip on the journal as shown. Install dowels/caps, tightening inward-to-outward in a crisscross pattern to10Nm. Do not rotate the cam during the measurement. Remove caps and read strip width using the product scale; required clearance0.028–0.062mm.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Identify the worn component when clearance fails
steps.instruction: If a journal clearance is outside0.028–0.062mm, measure that cam journal diameter. Required diameter22.002–22.015mm. An out-of-spec diameter requires the cam; an in-spec diameter with failed clearance requires the head and matching caps as a set. Record the decision for each failed location.
verification: Failed-location diameter and replacement decision recorded, or no failed clearance.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect chain and sprockets
steps.instruction: Check chain damage/stiffness and sprocket tooth wear against the drawing. More than one-quarter tooth wear requires camshaft and timing chain as a set; damaged/stiff chain requires the stated matching replacement set. Do not return a defective sprocket to service with only a new chain.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect the decompressor and preserve parts
steps.instruction: Verify the decompressor cam moves smoothly and its lever pin projects from the camshaft. Record the results. Remove all Plastigauge residue before assembly and keep the inspected cams/caps labeled for the installation operation.
verification: Decompressor result saved; measurement residue removed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow
